beats.headline: A cart full of blankets
beats.text: Carl and Donut find the Meadow Lark party, and among them is an old woman wrapped head to toe in scarves under a red checkered trapper hat, leaning on a shopping cart filled to the brim with blankets and odds and ends, a plastic pink flamingo with an arrow stuck in its head among them. Carl wonders how anyone got the wheelchairs and the cart down here. Agatha pulls a blue IKEA bag from the cart and sprays a smiley face on the wall. When Brandon tells her not to waste the paint, she says it is hers, and that he stole it from her.

beats.headline: Into Carl's inventory
beats.text: The borough boss is a rolling ball of tusklings, and it rushes past right where the party was standing, missing Agatha and her cart by inches while she cackles with joy. Carl orders her to sit down in the middle and not move, grabs the heavy cart from both sides, lifts it into the air and spends a few precious seconds putting it into his inventory. Thief, she cries. Thief. Yolanda promises he will give it back. Squeezed in with the six of them, Agatha goes on wailing about her damn shopping cart.

beats.headline: Given back, with suspicion
beats.text: The fight over, Agatha shuffles up to Carl shaking her fist, half her head caked in blood, and demands it back. He pulls the cart into existence a foot off the ground and it crashes down. She clutches an IKEA bag off the top and peers inside as if he might have stolen something, and pokes suspiciously at the flamingo. She could keep all of it in her own inventory, Carl points out. She hasn't gone through the tutorial, Yolanda says. She doesn't have an inventory yet.

beats.headline: Bully and a Thief
beats.text: Among the achievements after the borough boss fight, one confuses Carl for a moment. Bully and a Thief: he has stolen property from a fellow crawler who is a lower level than him. What's next, tough guy, the System asks, kicking puppies? The reward is a Bronze Asshole's Box. Then he realises he got it for taking Agatha's shopping cart.

beats.headline: Three items in the history
beats.text: Carl's inventory has grown a History tab. Sorted by value, its top three entries are things he has never seen: a Trans Tunnel 7C Orator Relay by Valtay Corp., a Valtay Perso-Shield Platinum Edition and a Mag 3040 Valtay Corp Pulse Pistol. The relay is a communication device, and illegal. Then Donut sees a blue dot coming, and he knows where they came from: Agatha's cart, all of it, held in his inventory through the boss fight. She wheels it in, squeaking, and calls him a cart thief. He offers to fix the wheel. No need to fix her squeak, she says.

beats.headline: Still squeaking, still pushing
beats.text: Carl moves to step down the stairs, and they suddenly turn into a ramp. A familiar crawler is pushing a squeaking shopping cart toward them: Agatha, level eight now, still human, still without a class, with the pink flamingo standing at the front of the cart. I see you lot are still kicking, she cackles. The whole group watches open-mouthed as she heads for the stairwell. Imani moves to intercept her, and Carl holds out a hand to stop her. Don't, he warns.

beats.headline: The bottom of the cart
beats.text: A countdown reaches every asset: commencement, Earth System initialization, edifice collapse, and this is not a drill. Agent number 22, also known as Agatha, shakes her head and reads it again. The night is freezing, and she has put her failing human shell into torpor against the cold. She takes her supplies out of her dimensional space, pulls herself to her feet with old, shaking hands, places the items in the IKEA bag and shoves it to the bottom of her shopping cart. The collapse is under two Earth hours away. She has been here almost ten Earth years, waiting.
